fluency.band9: Partly agrees (“To a large extent, it already has”), gives a counter-argument (“But I doubt…”), supports it, and concludes with “So…”.

grammar.band6: Error: “I think yes” (correct: “I think so”); “nobody writes” should be “nobody will write”.
grammar.band9: Present perfect with ellipsis (it already has), “I can't remember the last time…”, “in a way (that)…”, and “rather than + V-ing”.

analysis.keyDifference: Band 6 error: “I think yes” should be “I think so”. Band 9 gives a partly-agree answer and a prediction with a comparison structure (“more of a… than…”).
